description: Shared Go/Rust fixtures for the FB-A0/G1 file-extension contract. The blob's stored `e` (blob_e) is NOT authoritative: crawl-path torrents persist an empty `e`, so EVERY consumer (Go model.FileExtensionFromPath / blobmigration.ExtractUniqueExtensions, Rust file_extension_from_path / transform.rs file_extensions facet) MUST derive the extension from the file PATH and equal `expected_extension`, never trust blob_e. An empty string means 'no extension'. Both languages run these cases against their path-deriving function; they MUST agree.

cases.name: importer_path_e_matches
cases.note: importer path stored a populated e that already agrees with the path

cases.name: crawl_path_empty_e
cases.note: FB-A0 keystone: crawl-path blob carries empty e; consumers must still derive 'mkv' from the path

cases.name: multi_dot_tar_gz
cases.note: only the final extension token is taken

cases.name: dotfile_root
cases.note: leading dot is not an extension separator

cases.name: dotfile_in_dir
cases.note: dot preceded by a path separator is not an extension

cases.name: dot_only_in_directory
cases.note: the only dot is in a directory component, not the final segment

cases.name: single_file_torrent_name
cases.note: single-file torrent: extension derived from the torrent name/path

cases.name: stale_blob_e_wrong
cases.note: defensive: even a WRONG non-empty blob_e must be ignored in favour of the path-derived value
